scope: Retrospective frozen same-decoder prediction check within sci-Plex. Two matched but overlapping cohorts, never pooled as independent studies. No model/view/weight/threshold selection from outcomes.
landmarks: Source-only SHA256(seed|atomic_id), stable atomic_id secondary sort; one per source entity, then fill from remaining hash order. Shared across methods within each cohort/fold; no balancing/tuning.
panels: Existing heldout-fold source-control-A-selected 3000 genes in original rank order; no reselection and no target control inputs.
structured: source-vocabulary source_entity_key one-hot plus numerical dose one-hot; cosine; no cell/state fields; unknown categories fail
native: (binary Morgan Tanimoto or nonempty human target-ID set Jaccard + numerical dose equality)/2
fusion: 0.5*((raw complete-metadata cosine+1)/2) + 0.5*native_exposure; combine before source-only column standardization; no geometry/rank fusion
duplicate_inputs: Exact numeric feature/input rows evaluated once then broadcast for cosine and query prediction. All source observation rows and responses retained in fit; no tolerance merging.
decoder: Archived LandmarkRidge float64: source column population mean/std; std<1e-8 -> scale1; source Y mean unpenalized intercept; alpha10 fixed; no target truth parameter.
prediction_dtype: float32 scored as frozen; fitted kernels/parameters/source Y float64
same_drug_alias: Same scientific definition as legacy same_drug_dose_mean: exactly two other cell lines, same entity/dose/24h, within current matched source cohort.
scoring: Reuse unchanged prediction_metrics. Gene endpoints within fixed heldout line/dose/24h, all 3000 genes, >=20 unique entities. Truth ties excluded from order denominator; prediction ties0.5; constant Spearman NA, never zero.
contrasts: All non-same-drug methods vs same_drug (48); six CKvsC and KvsC (12); TFIDF CKvsC and KvsC (2); fusionvsC, fusionvsnative, nativevsC for six models in both cohorts (36):98 total. Positive gains: reference-minus-method errors, method-minus-reference correlations/order. Shared finite units only.
aggregation: Each fixed dose: equal query means or equal valid genes; each fold: equal valid dose means; cohort macro: equal valid heldout-fold means. Keep total/valid/NA units and children. Never pool the two cohorts or treat pairs/folds/models as independent biological n.
target_truth_access: Input archive may be physically decompressed to take allowed source rows per fold. No heldout truth passed to feature construction/fit. Seal all150 predictions before opening logical target truth for scoring.
